description: Renders a report definition (RDL or RDLC) or Markdown (a document, or slides: a page each) with SSRS2, the Report Viewer engine, and returns its pages as PNG, as a PDF of it would show them: a JSON summary first (what validate_report answers, no need to validate first; madeUpRows; conversion for Markdown, what it approximated at its lines; text, what the pages print, page by page in reading order, where values are read exactly), then an image per page, or one image of numbered thumbnails (sheet) to see a deck or a long report whole. A report with errors is not rendered. help: ["answers"] says more.

culture.description: The culture of a report that names no Language (en-US, de-CH); left out, en-US.

dpi.description: The images' dots per inch, 48 to 200 (default 96: an A4 page is 794 x 1123 pixels).

help.description: true, or topics (["markdown", "decks"]): the reference only.

madeUpRows.description: "all": every made-up row in the answer, not a summary.

markdown.description: Markdown's text: a document, or slides with marp: true. Give rdlc or markdown.

pages.description: Pages to return: 3 by default, 10 at most; with sheet, 30.

parameters.description: Report parameter values by name (a multi-value one's separated by commas).

pictures.description: The pictures the Markdown names, by its paths: {"images/chart.png": "<base64>"}; 5 MB each, 20 MB in all.

rdlc.description: The report definition's XML (RDL or RDLC). Give rdlc or markdown.

sampleData.description: Rows per dataset: {"DataSet": [{"Field": value}]}, dates as ISO text. Left out, made up from the fields' types.

sheet.description: One image of up to 30 pages as numbered thumbnails, too small to read: look at a page itself for that.

name: render_preview
title: Render a report's pages
